questions.question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• OWL → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• LUX → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• GHE → Two consonants and a vowel.
 
• BJP → Three consonants.

Hence, '**BJP**' is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the number-pairs share the same relationship as that shared by the given number-pair.

36 : 221
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First number × 6 + 5 = Second number**

 
• 36 : 221 → 36 × 6 + 5 = 216 + 5 = 221

Similarly,

 
• 43 : 263 → 43 × 6 + 5 = 258 + 5 = 263

Hence, '**43 : 263**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All caretakers are skilled.

Some skilled are lawyers.

All skilled are painters.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some painters are lawyers.

II. No painter is lawyer.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41892744fcdc26f39a41bac203ba5efe22fe8f07b66bea864664c0ae9e1f99f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some painters are lawyers. → **Follow** (As, Some skilled are lawyers and All skilled are painters)

II. No painter is lawyer. → Do not follow (As, Some skilled are lawyers and All skilled are painters → Some painters are lawyers)

Hence, '**Only conclusion I follows**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

12, 168, 7
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First Number × Third Number × 2 = Second Number**

 
• 12, 168, 7 → (12 × 7) × 2 = 168

Similarly,

 
• 14, 448, 16 → (14 × 16) × 2 = 448

Hence, '**14, 448, 16**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: If May 27, 2007, is Sunday, what will be the day of the week on May 25, 2018?
questions.solution:
There is one odd day in an ordinary year and two odd days in a leap year.

If **May 27, 2007, is Sunday**

May 27, 2008 - Tuesday

May 27, 2009 - Wednesday

May 27, 2010 - Thursday

May 27, 2011 - Friday

May 27, 2012 - Sunday

May 27, 2013 - Monday

May 27, 2014 - Tuesday

May 27, 2015 - Wednesday

May 27, 2016 - Friday

May 27, 2017 - Saturday

**May 27, 2018 - Sunday**

May 25, 2018 falls 2 days before May 27, 2018.

So, Sunday - 2 = Friday

Therefore, it was Friday on May 25, 2018.

Hence, '**Friday**' is the correct answer.

**Short-trick:**

As, there is one odd day in an ordinary year and two odd days in a leap year.

Number of odd days between May 27, 2007 to May 27, 2018 = 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 14

14 divided by 7 gives 0 as remainder.

So, it was Sunday on May 27, 2018.

Therefore, the day on May 25, 2018 = Sunday - 2 = Friday.

Hence, 'Friday' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the given Venn diagram, the rectangle 'people having blue eyes', the triangle represents 'people having extra fingers', and the circle represents 'people having dimples'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f1236b80d067db9c5ee458c211c9edfef1face96ba65d8ff19259324b3dc5e.png] 

The number of people who have extra fingers and blue eyes and no dimples is A and if the number of people who have extra fingers and dimples and no blue eyes is B. What is the sum of A and B?
questions.solution:
The number of people who have extra fingers and blue eyes and no dimples is A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9126be0a0df3efd7a5a37dcf4ea253a5e5bf2d480d6dea045ce4d905ae9dc5c2.png] 

 
• **A = 28**

The number of people who have extra fingers and dimples and no blue eyes is B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d61918f77aee84a110080891b870d611aa664518496f344c86a2cf0dd82c04e.png] 

 
• **B = 15**

The sum of A and B = 28 + 15 = 43

 Hence, '**43**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: 'Oven' is related to 'Baking' in the similar way as 'knife' is related to '________'.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 'Oven' is related to 'Baking' → **Baking** is a method of preparing food that uses dry heat, typically in an **oven**.

Similarly,

 
• 'knife' is related to '________' → **Chopping** means to cut something into pieces with repeated sharp blows of an axe or **knife**.

Hence, '**Chopping**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

38, 120, 366, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

38 × 3 + 6 = 114 + 6 = 120

120 × 3 + 6 = 360 + 6 = 366

366 × 3 + 6 = 1098 + 6 = 1104

Hence, '**1104**' is the correct answer.
